stone.intro: A standing stone on a low hill, taller than a rider. Words are cut deep into its face, and beneath them three hollows worn smooth by many hands.
stone.riddle: "Every wizard carries me, and I weigh nothing. Spent at dusk, I am back by dawn. Without me the mightiest spell is only a word. What am I?"
stone.tries: The stone remembers: you have answered wrongly {count} times.
stone.answer_a: Lay your hand in the first hollow: "A name."
stone.answer_b: Lay your hand in the second hollow: "Mana."
stone.answer_c: Lay your hand in the third hollow: "A shadow."
stone.wrong: The hollow is cold under your palm, and stays cold. Somewhere inside the rock, something settles, like a sigh.
stone.right: The hollow grows warm. A seam opens in the rock, and 100 gold spills out: the offerings of everyone who guessed before you.
stone.silent: The words have faded to a shadow on the rock. The stone has asked its question and been answered.
stone.hint_line1: You press your ear to the rock. Far inside, a voice like a spring under ice: "Think of what your lands give you, traveler, each morning."
stone.listen: Put your ear to the stone
